objective: First establish the user-directed specification, checklist, static HTML dashboard, and requirements-management loop. Make every required feature and correction statically and dynamically testable. Do not advance application refactoring until those process artifacts are complete.

acceptance.description: CMake configure and clean build succeed
QuickImageView.exe --self-test exits with code 0
All CTest cases pass
All current invariant source probes remain present
Build UI tests cover the custom resize dialog, user input, range selection, and menu policy
CLI conversion creates a new file and never changes or overwrites the source
Advertised encoder routes create valid output where codecs are available
Context-menu registration points to the installed executable and uninstall is scoped
The application displays file information and representative EXIF when present
Same-path rejection and CREATE_NEW reservation are implemented
Install, uninstall, and package scripts exist
MinGW static runtime linking is enabled
Separate save filters and selected-format extension fallback exist
Save As presents format, quality, and compression options before choosing the destination folder
User-specified positive percentage or pixel dimensions resize the image; no fixed value list is required
Resize has an aspect-ratio lock option enabled by default
A user-selected rectangle can be cropped
Pan, zoom, and range selection do not visibly flicker
Rotation and horizontal or vertical flip are available
A user-specified JPEG quality value is applied; no fixed candidate list is required
Full color, 256-color, and grayscale conversion are available
Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo without menu entries
Image clipboard copy and paste are available
WebP and HEIC/HEIF routes use available WIC codecs
Quality and compression settings are applied during conversion
